Title: Generally Available: Azure SQL Updates for Late-February

Body.Content:
In late-February 2025, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL:  

  • Monitor database availability for Azure SQL Database using the SLA-compliant Availability metric. Learn more.  

  • Use of native Windows principals for Azure SQL Managed Instance is now available. This capability simplifies the migration to Azure SQL Managed Instance and unblocks the migration of legacy applications that are tied to Windows logins. Learn more
